card.name: Start of early 1800s years
card.fires_on: Spots just before a year in the early-to-mid 1800s in historical or biographical text, such as the comma after a day and month, the first digit of a birth year, or the space before a decade. Also the word "the" before a 19th-century event.

modes.label: Before a birth or death year
modes.description: The comma after a month and day, or the digit 1 opening a year in parentheses, where an 1800s year follows.

modes.label: Before a decade or year
modes.description: The space after "In" or "of the" just before an 1800s year or decade.
modes.example: American entertainers of the<< >>1840s. The group

modes.label: Before a 19th-century event
modes.description: The word "the" before a named event of that era, such as a famine or war.
modes.example: During<< the>> Mexican War he was brevetted a

card.writes: It seems to push the next characters toward an early 1800s year, with unclear, mostly non-English promoted tokens.
card.plain: It fires in biographies when the next thing is likely a year in the 1800s.
